about: Words and phrases `node tools/polestar.js i18n leaks` (tools/lib/i18n/leaks.js) lets show in Latin letters on a non-English client.
A word one of the locale's own texts already uses (its interface translations, names pack or guide texts) needs no entry.
products: names that stay as they are in every language. terms: abbreviations and key names every client shows in English.
patterns: JavaScript regular expressions for links, slash commands and format directives.
locales: per locale, names the game itself keeps in English on that client. Entries match whole words, case and all.
The Western clients (German, Spanish, French, Portuguese) keep a few instance names in English: Zul'Gurub; Mazzranache is the same name in German.
